schema_version.description: Mapping-file schema version. RM-M4-07 ships v1; new versions must add a tested migration or backward-compatibility path before being accepted by the loader (Folgearbeit F-07).

node_id.description: OPC-UA NodeId per the spec: numeric (i=42), string (s=Battery.Soc), GUID (g=...) or opaque/base64 (b=...). Optional namespace prefix ns=N;. Validation is structural only (RM-M4-07 D-04); semantic existence in the server namespace is verified by RM-M4-04 at adapter discovery time.

direction.description: EMS-perspective direction. 'read' = the EMS reads on demand; 'subscribe' = the EMS receives MonitoredItem updates; 'write' = the EMS writes setpoints.

data_type.description: OPC-UA built-in data type. Maps onto the .NET runtime type at the adapter boundary.

scale_factor.description: engineering_value = raw_value * scale_factor; scale_factor=0 would collapse all reads to 0 and divide writes by zero. Default 1 if omitted.

monitoring_interval_ms.description: MonitoredItem sampling interval in milliseconds. Only meaningful for direction='subscribe'; ignored otherwise.
